name: Landorus
description: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: The user bites the target with viciously sharp fangs to inflict damage.

moves.name: Twister
moves.description: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the target.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user tramples its target into the ground, dealing damage. This also lowers the target’s action speed.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, raising its offensive and defensive stats.

moves.name: Extrasensory
moves.description: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's defensive stats.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's defensive stats.

moves.name: Sandsear Storm
moves.description: The user attacks by wrapping the target in fierce winds and searingly hot sand. This also leaves the target with a burn.
